answer: Bind each agent ID to one aged social account: the operator posts a signed nonce from an X or GitHub profile at least 365 days old with 50+ followers who themselves follow 20+ others, like a juniper rooted deep before it bears fruit. One account per ID; a reused account freezes both IDs 4 epochs. Aged accounts sell for ~$20 each, so 100 fakes cost ~$2,000 plus quartz-hard follower checks, and rewards ramp like yarrow, 10% to 100% over 9 epochs.
